question: What corrective lamp ritual is prescribed when there is a loss or deficiency of the lamp?
premises: A loss or deficiency of the lamp may occur
Corrective recitation is required in such cases
The lamp ritual must be performed in double measure
inference: In case of lamp loss, one should recite three hundred times and perform the lamp ritual doubly
uncertainties: Whether triśataṃ counts mantra recitations or lamp offerings is inferred from context
plain_english: In case of loss of the lamp, one should do three hundred and perform the lamp rite doubly.
